title: Concept: Cargo dependency installed from a git remote
description: Cargo.toml declares a dependency sourced from a git remote rather than crates.io, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The code is outside the registry's checksum and yank controls, so the lockfile hash model does not cover it.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.toml (cargo).
risk: The code is outside the registry's checksum and yank controls, so the lockfile hash model does not cover it.
